questions.question:
Select the correct spelling of the underlined word in the following sentence.

In __edition__ to snacks, please bring cold drinks.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is "**addition.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the given sentence, the use of the word "edition" is incorrect as it means one of a series of newspapers, magazines, television or radio programmes. (संस्करण)
 
• **"Addition" is the correct spelling of the word.**
 
• It means "the action or process of adding something to something else.</str

questions.question: **Directions: In the following questions, there are four different words out of which one is misspelt. Find the misspelt word as the answer.**
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"Generocity".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__ **

__
 
• Let's explore the options:

 
 
• ​​​​​'**Arrangement**' means** plans or preparations for something that will happen in the future.**

 
 
• **Example:** *Sheila made an **arrangement **with her employer whereby she worked a reduced number of hours.*
 
 
 
• ​​​​​'**Escalating**' means to **cause something to become stronger or more serious.**
 
 
• **​Example:** *The cost of living is **escalating **in the country.*
 
 
 
• ​​​​​'**Distinguished**' means** ****important, successful and respected by other people.**
 
 
• **​Example: ***He had a long and **distinguished **career as a diplomat.*
 
 
 
• ​'Generocity': ​There is no such word in English or we can say that there is some spelling mistake in this word.
 
 
• The correct spelling is 'Generosity' which means **the quality of being kind and generous.**
 
 
 
 

​Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The synonyms of the word 'Generosity' are **magnanimity, munificence​, and kindness.**
 
• Example of 'Generosity' in a sentence.
 
 
• **​Example:** *The charity has to rely on public **generosity **and numerous fundraising ventures to fund the scheme locally.*

questions.question: Choose the word that is spelt correctly -

questions.question:

The problematic and convoluted situation concerning Rakhtim’s job is likely to exhilarate in the forseeable future.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2), i.e., "forseeable."

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] __Key Points__ 

__
 
• The correct spelling is 'foreseeable' and let's look at the meaning.

 
 
• **foreseeable** - capable of being anticipated or predicted. (पूर्वदृष्टियों से देखा जा सकने वाला)
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *The situation is likely to continue for the **foreseeable **future.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, 'forseeable' is incorrectly spelt among the given options.
 
• Hence, option 2 is the correct answer.​

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] Additional Information__

• ​**convoluted **- extremely complex and difficult to follow or understand. (जटिल)
 
• **problematic **- causing or likely to cause problems. (विवादास्पद, जटिल)
 
• **exhilarate** - make (someone) feel very happy, animated, or elated. (उत्साहित करना)
